stack.name: Gull Rock
stack.crown_why: the crown plate is 20 blocks over the sea (y82 where the sea is y62), 26 over the bed at the centre (y56): the heightmap's slope falls from y109 at x6520 to the beach, so a crown at y82 + the Gullmother's height is in terrain line of sight from the moor's fall inland (tools/rookery.py report, along z=2650, from x6480 at the end of its scan, with two small gaps). Lower and the shore's own dune would hide it; higher and a crown plate would read as a tower, not a rock
stack.profile_why: the radius of the rock at a height is r_base - (r_base - r_top) * ((h - base) / (crown - base)) ** (1 / profile_exp): an exponent under 1 keeps the faces steep and gives the talus a wide skirt, which is what a stack looks like, and the top r_top is a flat plate 3.4 blocks in radius for the Gullmother (Cobblemon 1.8.0 species data/cobblemon/species/generation1/dragonite.json: hitbox 2 wide, 3.2 high, baseScale 0.9)
stack.wobble_why: the outline is not a circle: a smooth angular noise of three harmonics (phases from the seed) moves the radius by up to 16%, so no two faces read alike. Deterministic, no randomness
stack.foundation_why: rock is written from two blocks under the heightmap's rounded bed, so a bed that exports a block lower than the heightmap (the water export moved coasts 10-16 blocks, STATE N2) leaves no gap of water under the stack

guano.why: a rookery is white: guano streaks run down the faces from the ledges, and a scatter of it lies on the higher rock. Calcite, white terracotta and diorite: none is a spawn-condition block (white wool, quartz and every concrete are, data/spawn_blocks.json)

stack.ledges_why: three nest ledges on the landward faces (bearings are compass: 0 north, 90 east, 270 west), where the beach and the moor see them: a flat shelf of the face's own rock sticking out of it 2 blocks, with a wall of hay (the nest) along its outer lip

crown_nest.why: the Gullmother's own nest: a half ring of hay on the crown plate's rim, open to the east (the sea side) so she is seen against the sky from the west only through its gap. A single block high, never over the centre column

skerries.ring_why: ring_radius 34 is spawn_range 16 + the Gullmother's leash 16 + 2: the closest a Habitat Block may stand to her (tests/test_resident_siting.py: a resident's fight does not overlap a nest). Six dome rocks 3.6 in radius and 3 over the sea (y65), 60 degrees apart from bearing 30, so the colony wheels round her on all sides and the nearest to the beach (bearing 270 sits between two of them) is a short swim from the shallows. Tidal rocks, not an islet: a gull stands on one, a player can too (it recovers swim fatigue: land recovers it, STATE 'Surface exhaustion')
skerries.block_why: each skerry's Habitat Block sits in its rock one block under the top, the Driftmouth Isle stacks' way (data/sea_drift.json waters)

residents.name: Gull Rock
residents.kind: a rookery: a colony round one great bird on a stack in the sea
residents.situation: Off the long beach of the eastern moor a grey stack stands out of the shallows, white down its faces, ledged with hay-thatched nests, and the gulls of the whole coast turn above it. Six tidal rocks lie round it in a ring. On the crown, in a half-ring of her own nest, sits the Gullmother, an old Dragonite: the sailors of the strait say she turns lost ships home in a storm, and that nobody has rowed up to her twice. You see the stack from the moor's high edge, a long way off, and the birds before the rock.

pokemon.name: the Gullmother
pokemon.message: The Gullmother opens her wings over the nest, and every gull on the coast goes up with her.
pokemon.level_why: 55 is the lowest level a wild Dragonite can honestly be: Dragonair evolves into it at minLevel 55 (Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar, data/cobblemon/species/generation1/dragonair.json). It is also tier 7's ceiling (data/encounter_design.json rules.hearts.next_cap['7'] = 55) and gym 8's ace (data/trainers.json gym_ace_levels[7] = 55), which is the cap of a player with seven badges. The player at the sweep's bands 5-6 holds a cap of 45-50: she is 10 over the one and 5 over the other, a Dragonite of 600 base stat total against parties on 40-48, and its dex text (jar: cobblemon.species.dragonite.desc) is why she is here at all: 'a kindhearted Pokemon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land'. Not a pseudo-legendary handed to an early visitor: the fight is open from the first day (she is there, asleep, visible, ungated), and the catch is not
